in_sanskrit.name: PranShu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pran means life and Shu means to protect or nourish. So, PranShu means to protect or nourish life.

in_hindi.name: प्रंशु
in_hindi.long_meaning: Pranshu in Hindi can be translated to Shakti which means power or strength.

in_tamil.name: பிரந்சு
in_tamil.long_meaning: Pranshu in Tamil can be translated to Viduthalai which means ruler or leader.

in_telugu.name: ప్రంశు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Pranshu in Telugu can be translated to Pesamu which means very dear or beloved.

in_marathi.name: Pranshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Living or moving around
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who keeps moving or is always active

in_bengali.name: Pranshu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Living or moving around
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pranshu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who keeps moving or is always active
